disagreements.topic: Size of the haircut to FY28 consensus EPS ($23.85)
disagreements.positions: agent_2 -1.5% ($23.5), agent_5 -6% ($22.5), agent_1 and agent_4 -8% ($22.0), agent_3 -10% ($21.5). Agents 1, 3 and 4 justify the larger haircut the same way: consensus FY28 revenue is +20% while SEMI's July forecast has 2028 WFE only +14.1% (~$200B).
disagreements.resolution: That reason is out of date. At SEMICON Taiwan (Sept 1, 2026) SEMI's Clark Tseng raised the 2028 WFE forecast to $220B from ~$200B in July. On an unchanged ~$175B 2027 base, that is ~+25% for 2028, in line with or above consensus revenue +20%. The Sept-29 consensus probably already reflects this, so it is not upside to consensus. But it removes the stated case for an 8-10% haircut. A generic late-cycle haircut of ~4-5% (NTM EPS ~$22.8) is still reasonable. agent_5 was the only one to find and use the September upgrade.
disagreements.evidence: Digitimes 2026-09-01 (SEMI senior director Clark Tseng at SEMICON Taiwan: 2028 WFE raised to $220B from ~$200B); SEMI July 14 mid-year release (Yahoo Finance syndication: WFE +21.8% in 2027 and +14.1% in 2028 to ~$200B).

disagreements.positions: Fair values have converged to $505-515 (mean $511.4). Multiples: 21-23.5x on NTM EPS, with ~$8/share net cash in every model (a partial discount of the equity stakes; the 10-Q gives $10.0/share in full, $7.0 excluding them).
disagreements.resolution: There is no factual dispute left. The spread in fair value comes from the EPS haircut, not the multiple. With NTM EPS ~$22.8 x 22.5x + $10.0 net cash (10-Q), I get ~$523. Caveat: all five adopted the round-1 supervisor's net cash, consensus and multiple band, so their agreement is not five independent confirmations.
disagreements.evidence: Agents' round-2 fair_value.methods; MarketScreener consensus (via round 1). Q3 FY26 10-Q balance sheet (net cash $7,957M, 793.6M shares).

disagreements.topic: BIS Affiliates Rule / US-China truce date
disagreements.positions: All five now list 2027-01-10. agents 2 and 5 call the extension a single secondary report. agent_4 adds Fibre2Fashion.
disagreements.resolution: The truce extension to Jan 10, 2027 is confirmed by mainstream outlets: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced it on Sep 23 (NBC News, Yahoo Finance). Whether it also extends the Affiliates Rule suspension could not be confirmed from a primary source: the Steptoe update citing unnamed officials would not open, and the Federal Register has no BIS notice extending the suspension (searched 2026-10-15), so that claim is dropped. The suspension otherwise ends on Nov 10, 2026 (Yahoo Finance), after the 1-month window and inside the 12-month horizon. The Affiliates Rule binary is therefore Nov 10, 2026 unless the suspension is formally extended, possibly to Jan 10, 2027.
disagreements.evidence: NBC News / Yahoo: US and China agree to extend trade truce through Jan. 10 (Bessent); Yahoo: Affiliates Rule originally suspended until Nov. 10, 2026; Federal Register search for a BIS extension notice (none as of 2026-10-15).

one_month_reasoning: I keep the round-2 mean. AMAT's FQ4 report is expected in mid-November (FQ4 FY25 was reported on Nov 13, 2025, per its 8-K), outside the window. Micron tonight (not yet out when checked), Samsung ~Oct 7, ASML Oct 14, TSMC ~Oct 15, Lam Oct 21 and hyperscaler capex in late October are two-sided. The Affiliates Rule suspension runs to Nov 10, 2026 unless it is extended with the truce (reported, not confirmed), so that date is outside the window either way. The stock was trading ~$509 intraday on Sep 30, with no news.
confidence_reason: The round-2 forecasters converged on the round-1 fact-checks, so the mean already carries them. My one new fact is SEMI's Sept 1 upgrade of 2028 WFE to $220B (a named SEMI director, reported by Digitimes). It undercuts the specific reason three agents gave for 8-10% EPS haircuts, which justifies a small ~1.5% upward shift. But consensus likely already reflects it, and the Sept-2027 multiple, which no search can settle, dominates. The agents' convergence is also partly herding on one supervisor's inputs.
thesis_break_reason: $335 is ~18x FY27 consensus ($18.4) and ~15x a ~$22.8 NTM EPS, and ~19% below the $415.38 Sept-16 closing low that came on sentiment alone. A close there would mean a real 2027-28 WFE downturn is being priced: capex cuts at the October customer prints or in Micron's FY27 guide, an AMAT guide-down at the mid-November FQ4 report or in February, or the Affiliates Rule returning (Nov 10, 2026 unless its suspension is extended with the truce to Jan 10, 2027). Agents' range is $330-340.

summary: In round 2 the five forecasters took up the round-1 corrections and converged: fair values $505-515 (mean $511), P(>=512) 0.515-0.56. The remaining spread is the size of the FY28 EPS haircut. Three agents justified 8-10% with SEMI's July 2028 WFE figure, which SEMI raised from ~$200B to $220B on Sept 1, so I nudge the centre up ~1.5% (fair value ~$523, P(>=512) 0.545), with medium confidence because the Sep-2027 multiple dominates and the convergence is partly herding. Micron reports tonight (not out when checked); then the October customer capex prints, AMAT's FQ4 report in mid-November, the Nov 10 Affiliates Rule date (an extension is reported but unconfirmed) and the Jan-10-2027 truce deadline announced by Treasury.

sizing.entry: 3 tranches over ~6 weeks: after Micron (Sep 30) and TSMC/ASML (mid-Oct), after Lam (Oct 21), and after AMAT FQ4 (mid-November)
sizing.overlap: None. The portfolio is all cash; this would be its only semicap/AI-capex exposure.
sizing.reason: Fair value (~$523) is within ~2% of the price, so the edge is thin. The stock has ~60% realised volatility and fell 42.5% close-to-close this summer (Jun 30 $723.00 to Sep 16 $415.38, Twelve Data daily closes) without a fundamental shock. Dated events (October capex prints, mid-November earnings, the Nov 10 Affiliates Rule date and the Jan 10 truce deadline) argue for staged entry and a cap of ~8% for a single high-beta cyclical; liquidity is not a constraint. The corrected (larger) drawdown supports the 8% cap rather than arguing for a higher one.
